caption: The video captures an outdoor grassy clearing bordered by bare shrubs and trees, with a small red-roofed building on the left hillside. A person stands at the right edge holding two long red poles angled upward, their tips joined by a thin string loop that forms a giant-bubble wand. A large iridescent soap film hangs in the center, attached to that wand. The film progressively bulges outward and grows in volume, becoming a big rounded, teardrop-like bubble. Its surface displays continuously shifting rainbow iridescence and flowing color bands as it expands. The bubble's right side gradually pulls free of the wand's string loop, leaving the strings to dangle as a separate vertical line beside it. The person keeps the poles raised in a nearly steady grip, making only minor adjustments. The background and the person drift rightward across the scene, distinct from the bubble's own expansion.
